segments.text: from A to Z as it relates to student life, as it relates to RSOs.
segments.zh: 关于学生生活、关于注册学生社团的一切，从头到尾都讲到。

segments.text: This is not the session.

segments.text: However, with this session, what I hope to do, what I hope to accomplish for this session
segments.zh: 不过，通过这次课程，我希望做到的，我希望这次课程能达成的，

segments.text: is rather to give you a very broad overview of the policies and procedures, sharing with

segments.text: So stay tuned.

segments.text: I hope this session for you is very informative and it should last about 20 to 25 minutes.
segments.zh: 希望这次课程对你们来说信息量丰富，时长大约 20 到 25 分钟。

segments.text: This will be a classroom full of students, advisors, officers, leaders, etc.
segments.zh: 这会是一个坐满了学生、指导老师、干部、负责人等的教室。

segments.text: However, this first slide, I would like for you to give your name, your organization,

segments.zh: 再说一遍，我叫 Dee Lindsey。

segments.text: I'm representing the Office of Student Life as a Director.
segments.zh: 我以主任的身份代表学生生活处。

segments.text: Today we're going to talk about some of the benefits for the RSOs.
segments.zh: 今天我们要讲讲注册学生社团的一些福利。

segments.text: Specifically, you will have the opportunity as a recognized student organization to book
segments.zh: 具体来说，作为注册学生社团，你们有机会在各自的校区

segments.text: space on your particular campus completely free of charge.
segments.zh: 完全免费地预订场地。

segments.text: You will receive an automatic invitation to Club Rush in the fall and in the spring.
segments.zh: 你们会自动收到秋季和春季社团招新会（Club Rush）的邀请。

segments.text: And you will also have the opportunity to open an agency account.
segments.zh: 你们还有机会开设一个代管账户（agency account）。

segments.text: I have to give you a word of caution here about agency accounts.
segments.zh: 关于代管账户，我得在这里提醒大家一句。

segments.text: As much as I love my own particular financial institution, for recognized student organizations,
segments.zh: 虽然我很喜欢我自己用的那家金融机构，但对于注册学生社团来说，

segments.text: there can be no outside bank accounts.
segments.zh: 不能有任何校外银行账户。

segments.text: No Robbins Federal, no Bank of America, no BB&T, etc., etc.
segments.zh: 不能用 Robins Federal，不能用 Bank of America，不能用 BB&T，等等等等。

segments.text: I also want to make sure that everyone understands that when you fund rates, all deposits must
segments.zh: 我还要确保大家都明白，当你们募集资金时，所有存款都必须

segments.text: be deposited directly into your agency account.
segments.zh: 直接存入你们的代管账户。

segments.text: Another benefit is you have the opportunity to be nominated at our spring leadership awards,
segments.zh: 另一个福利是，你们有机会被提名参加我们的春季领导力奖评选，

segments.text: which will be held in the spring.
segments.zh: 评选将在春季举行。

segments.text: You will also be eligible for co-op funding.
segments.zh: 你们还有资格获得 COA 资助。

segments.text: And additionally, you will have the opportunity to obtain free consultation on major event planning
segments.zh: 此外，你们还有机会获得关于大型活动策划

segments.text: and implementation.

segments.text: Registering your student organizations.
segments.zh: 注册你们的学生社团。

segments.text: You must register every year to be a recognized student organization.
segments.zh: 要成为注册学生社团，你们必须每年注册一次。

segments.text: What does registration actually mean?
segments.zh: 注册到底意味着什么？

segments.text: That means attending training, much like you're doing today.
segments.zh: 意味着参加培训，就像你们今天这样。

segments.text: That means submitting your recognition documents, which includes your advisor intent form.
segments.zh: 意味着提交认证文件，其中包括指导老师意向表。

segments.text: It also includes your drug and alcohol free campus forms, your roster, and information
segments.zh: 还包括无毒品无酒精校园表格、成员名册，以及

segments.text: about your agency account.
segments.zh: 关于代管账户的信息。

segments.text: Registration, or re-registration as it were, begins with the first day of the fall semester
segments.zh: 注册，或者说重新注册，从秋季学期第一天开始，

segments.text: and ends the last business day in September.
segments.zh: 到九月最后一个工作日结束。

segments.text: For the spring semester, recognition or registration begins the first day of the spring semester
segments.zh: 对于春季学期，认证或注册从春季学期第一天开始，

segments.text: and ends the last business day in February.
segments.zh: 到二月最后一个工作日结束。

segments.text: It is important to understand that this recognition process is important for a number of reasons

segments.text: on a regular basis about upcoming events in student life, student affairs, and business
segments.zh: 沟通学生生活、学生事务以及学院事务方面

segments.text: of the college.
segments.zh: 即将举行的活动。

segments.text: Once I have all of those forms together, I will delete my current distribution list,
segments.zh: 等我把所有这些表格收齐，我会删掉现有的通讯名单，

segments.zh: 把你们所有人加到新的通讯名单里，这样我就能

segments.zh: 定期和你们沟通，还是那句话，关于学生生活方面的事务。

segments.text: Talk about transition for just a moment.
segments.zh: 我们来稍微谈一下交接。

segments.text: Why should organizations transition?
segments.zh: 社团为什么要做交接？

segments.text: There are a couple of good reasons why.
segments.zh: 有几个很好的理由。

segments.text: You can, when you transition, transfer that significant organizational knowledge.
segments.zh: 通过交接，你们可以传承那些重要的组织知识。

segments.text: You can help your incoming leadership by absorbing the special expertise of your outgoing leadership.
segments.zh: 你们可以让新任负责人吸收卸任负责人的专门经验，从而帮助他们。

segments.text: How can you transition?
segments.zh: 怎样做交接呢？

segments.text: A couple of ways.
segments.zh: 有几种方法。

segments.text: You can do it by training.
segments.zh: 可以通过培训。

segments.text: In-house training for your particular RSL.
segments.zh: 在你们自己的 RSO 内部进行培训。

segments.text: You can also do it by just simply observing your current officers.
segments.zh: 也可以简单地观察你们现任的干部。

segments.text: You can plan a retreat for your recognized student organization.
segments.zh: 可以为你们的注册学生社团策划一次集训。

segments.text: Or, my personal favorite, you can begin to assemble a transition notebook.
segments.zh: 或者，我个人最喜欢的，你们可以开始整理一本交接手册。

segments.text: In student life, we've done just that.
segments.zh: 在学生生活处，我们就是这么做的。

segments.text: Across all five campuses, we now have transition notebooks in place that kind of gives
segments.zh: 在全部五个校区，我们现在都有了交接手册，它大致

segments.text: a very broad overview of what each person who is a student life professional,
segments.zh: 概括了每一位学生生活工作人员

segments.text: what their job entails.
segments.zh: 的工作内容。

segments.text: For instance, a little while ago, the Office of Student Life suffered
segments.zh: 比如，前一阵子，学生生活处

segments.text: two major exits due to employee transitions.

segments.text: Before the two employees left, I worked with them to actually put together
segments.zh: 在这两位员工离开之前，我和他们一起

segments.text: their transition notebook, which has now been very instrumental
segments.zh: 整理了他们的交接手册，现在这本手册

segments.zh: 对新员工大致了解这个岗位到底要做什么起了很大的作用。
